FN-V7N9SVL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 271
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 271 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Rengage Alabama Grant
program by up to $3,000 for each individual who qualifies to participate in the program that
otherwise would not have qualified by: (1) lowering the minimum eligible age of a participant
from 25, under current law, to 22 years old; and (2) allowing individuals to participate in the
program to obtain a baccalaureate degree after having received an associates degree, if they have
not previously received a ReEngage Alabama grant.
